intro: ICCR Academy runs on a blended-learning model: accredited, live online academics during the day, taught alongside in-person Islamic studies — all held within the Masjid, guided by Muslim administrators, staff, and instructors.

islamic.title: Islamic Studies Curriculum

academic.title: Academic Curriculum
